headline: Eleven live conversations, one booked. The stone says the same thing four ways: work the queue, book the calls, send Kyle the proof.

sections.title: Bottleneck
sections.text: Booking. Week reply rate 2.7 percent (11 of 412, MEASURED) cleared most of the distance to the 3 percent floor, then 10 of 11 replies stalled untagged. Week booking rate 9.1 percent against the 35 percent baseline (RYAN-VERIFIED).

sections.title: Levers in euros
sections.text: One, book the queue at baseline: at 11 replies a week and 35 percent booking, roughly 12 incremental booked calls a month worth about EUR 7,500 a month at assumed show 70, close 17.5, EUR 5k cash per close. Basis: measured reply flow, verified KPI, assumed downstream. Two, Kyle: up to EUR 10,000 one time, price accepted on call (MEASURED), blocked only on proof; send the vault today. Three, volume back to 100 a day: about EUR 4,600 a month at this week's measured reply rate. Basis: measured reply rate, assumed downstream. Levers overlap, never sum.

sections.title: Strategic moves
sections.text: Inside the gates: no second setter (booking 13.3 percent all time is below the 35 gate), no new niche test (trading is the pipeline but send data is under 300 per challenger). The one move that respects every gate: fleet buildout, accounts 2 and 3, which is risk removal for the main account, not just capacity. ETA remains an OPEN QUESTION.

sections.title: What you would miss
sections.text: The reply surge itself. Rates tripled on flat volume, which means something in the messaging changed and worked. Identify it, write it down, do not drift off it.

sections.title: Do not touch
sections.text: The ladder and message set that produced 11 replies. The parked lead scheduler (standby by doctrine). Pricing doctrine. The EOD habit, 15 straight logged days.

sections.title: Training questions
sections.text: One: after a positive reply goes quiet before booking, what is the standard post reply cadence, day by day? The ladder covers pre reply only and 10 conversations are sitting in exactly this gap. Two: what changed in the messaging or targeting last week that tripled the reply rate? The stone wants it codified before it drifts.
